title: Reuse retained same-plane Forest endpoints through the canonical indexed block owner

predecessor_gate.decision: GPU-35 licensed one later minimal in-place same-plane production experiment preserving retained-hyperedge/undirected refusal order, bounded-entry behavior, explicit unknown row/column membership errors, canonical block identity and exact Fourfold subject binding while reusing the existing TypedRelationBlock._from_indexed owner.

implementation.observation: Same-plane Fourfold retention identifies exact Forest relation payloads but does not independently establish endpoint membership, while the existing adapter preserved correct refusal ordering and then readmitted labels through TypedRelationBlock.from_coordinates before reaching the already-existing indexed owner.
implementation.change: Preserve retained-hyperedge and undirected scans/refusals plus MAX_BLOCK_ENTRIES while collecting retained directed endpoints; only after those scans map endpoint labels explicitly to the canonical same-plane axis, preserve the exact unknown-row/unknown-column errors, and delegate to TypedRelationBlock._from_indexed.

focused_regressions.name: test_same_plane_projection_reuses_retained_endpoints_without_coordinate_readmission
focused_regressions.method: Monkeypatch TypedRelationBlock.from_coordinates to fail, then require the retained same-plane imports projection to preserve the exact expected entry and Fourfold subject digest.
focused_regressions.purpose: Pins removal of duplicate same-plane coordinate readmission without adding a second validation owner.

focused_regressions.name: test_same_plane_projection_preserves_explicit_plane_membership_errors
focused_regressions.method: Use bounded same-plane snapshots with one retained endpoint absent from the selected plane and require exact unknown-column and unknown-row ValueError messages.
focused_regressions.purpose: Pins the endpoint-membership semantics that Fourfold relation retention alone does not establish.

focused_regressions.existing_surface: Retained hyperedge refusal, undirected-edge refusal, empty retention, exact typed-axis reuse and exact Forest/Fourfold subject binding remain exercised by the existing focused projection suite.

hosted_evidence.checkout_semantics: GitHub pull-request merge preview; PR-integration evidence, not a raw-head checkout claim
hosted_evidence.contract_matrix: Python 3.10/3.12 x PYTHONHASHSEED 0/123456 jobs completed successfully
hosted_evidence.integrated_contract_surface: success; includes tests/twin and the focused GPU-36 regressions

decision: Keep the same-plane indexed projection as the single in-place implementation licensed by GPU-35. Hosted integration evidence supports compatibility on the exercised semantic surface; GPU-36 has no new controlled production pre/post A/B and therefore makes no performance claim.
next_bounded_packet: Re-evaluate prioritized Tensor/Fourfold issues and the current cost surface. Prefer deletion/consolidation or a separately evidenced bottleneck; do not add another projection validator, trusted constructor, or parallel block-building abstraction.
